title: His mother was born in Odisha and studied at Delhi University before Harvard. In 2026, her son became mayor of America's largest city.

sources.text: WHRO Public Media - Zohran Mamdani sworn in as New York City mayor, capping historic rise

caption:
His mother was born in Odisha and studied at Delhi University before Harvard. In 2026, her son became mayor of America's largest city.

He won the election with 50.4% of the vote against Andrew Cuomo's 41.6%, becoming the first person of South Asian heritage to lead America's largest city.

She studied at Delhi University before earning a scholarship to Harvard, going on to direct acclaimed films including Salaam Bombay! and Monsoon Wedding - Mamdani himself was born in Kampala, Uganda and moved to New York at age seven.

Mamdani's path - an India-born mother's education and career feeding into her son's rise to lead New York City - shows the diaspora's influence compounding across generations, not fading with distance.
